raw.author: soso_beauty
raw.text_ko: 내돈내산 쌍수 후기입니다. 하늘성형외과 강남점에서 김도윤 원장님께 매몰법으로 했어요. 견적은 180 나왔고 부가세 별도였어요. D+30 지금 붓기 거의 빠졌고 라인 자연스러워서 만족합니다. 실밥은 5일차에 풀었어요.

extraction.text_en: This is a self-paid (I paid with my own money) double eyelid surgery review. I had it done with the buried suture method by Director Kim Do-yoon at Haneul Plastic Surgery Gangnam branch. The quote came out to 1.8 million won, VAT not included. Now at D+30, the swelling has mostly gone down and the line looks natural, so I'm satisfied. The stitches were removed on day 5.

trust_reasons: +0.05 self-paid claim ['내돈내산'] (cheap to fake; small weight)
+0.10 named surgeon 김도윤 is on clinic's specialist roster (verified surgeon)
